original_requirement: S07: source counts and completeness diagnostics use consistent observations.
observed_gap: The normal freshness call obtains a disk inventory for change detection, then independently walks the same checkout to compute completeness expectations.
behavior: Reuse the complete nonempty path inventory captured during disk change detection. Observation failure and explicit check_disk=false retain independent completeness behavior.
limitations: Current build excludes this source commit. No compile or runtime gain has been measured.
